title: Mem0 — where the paper and the code part ways
subtitle: Only the divergent steps are drawn. Each node states both sides; the lane says which stage of the pipeline the divergence sits in.
source: paper arXiv:2504.19413  ×  repo mem0 @ dae67f74   ·   servers/mem0/verification.md, 107 assertions checked (77 ✓ / 7 ✗ / 22 ◐ / 1 ?)
footer: memory-bench · methodology flow · paper ↔ code divergence
legend_notes: The headline: Mem0's named contribution is the four-operation memory update. In the OSS package that operation set is ADD-only, and the prompt says so in as many words.
Everything the code added instead (BM25, entity boost, fusion, threshold gate, raw-dialogue store) sits in stages the paper never describes.
Net effect: the paper's system is smart at A3 ADMIT and vague at B2-B5. The code is the exact mirror image.
